text:
alex_k: Quick heads-up — planning a coordinated cut tomorrow 10:00am PT. We need version bumps in API, runtime, console, and SDKs. Cutoff for merges is 9:00am PT. If you have late work, call it out now.
maria_s: Ack. I have one last console changelog PR (#842) — should be tiny. Can land before cutoff. Will ping when done.
rafael: Runtime: I still have a perf tweak PR (#1287) that might go in. If it looks flaky on CI, I'd prefer to hold it for the next minor. Anyone object to postponing if CI flakes?
sneh: No objections from infra. If runtime PR touches kernel selection, we should avoid last-minute changes. Rafael, do you know if it changes the kernel config?
rafael: It tweaks the kernel selection heuristic for short sequences (only opt-in). Unit tests pass but integration runs are still in progress. I'll mark it for post-cut if integration fails.
alex_k: Sounds good. @rafael mark PR as "post-cut" if integration doesn't finish. We want release stability over micro-optimizations.
maria_s: Console: I'll do the changelog and bump package.json to 1.12.0-rc.1 once API/runtime tags are set. I have the changelog entry drafted.
alex_k: API: who's cutting the tag? I can do the git tag if someone can confirm the API schema PR (#456) is final.
sneh: API schema PR merged to release branch this morning. No outstanding blockers from my side. CI green.
alex_k: OK I'll cut the API RC tag after 9:15am PT once I verify the release branch is stable.
maria_s: For SDKs: Please ensure the client generator runs after API tag. SDKs need the new openapi schema. Rafael, any runtime changes affecting client behavior?
rafael: No client-facing changes from runtime. SDKs should be fine once API schema is published.
alex_k: Quick checklist I'm adding to the release thread:
- verify all release branches green
- cut API tag (alex_k)
- publish openapi schema (alex_k)
- run SDK generator + publish prerelease (maria_s)
- bump console package + changelog (maria_s)
- confirm runtime tag & no kernel config changes (rafael)
- final smoke tests by devops-bot
devops-bot: CI summary — api: green, console: green, runtime: running integration (20m left). :hourglass:
maria_s: I'll wait for the API tag then run the SDK generator. ETA 20-30 mins after tag.
alex_k: Example commands I'll run to cut tags (for whoever needs them):
```
# api
git checkout release/v1.12
git pull origin release/v1.12
git tag -a v1.12.0-rc.1 -m "rc1"
git push origin v1.12.0-rc.1
```
alex_k: If anyone can't meet the cutoff, say so now. Otherwise I'll proceed with the sequence tomorrow 9:15am PT and aim for full cut at 10:00am PT.
rafael: Integration finished: runtime looks good. I'll cut the runtime tag at 9:30am PT and ping here with the tag name.
release-bot: Release checklist updated — all required steps present. Will run smoke tests after tags are pushed.
maria_s: Console bumped to 1.12.0-rc.1 and changelog published. PR -> #842. SDK generator queued.
alex_k: Thanks all. I'll post final timestamps here once tags are pushed. Small ask: please avoid force pushes to release branches during the 9:00–10:30am PT window. :lock:
sneh: Noted. We'll hold infra changes.
alex_k: Closing thread — will follow up with the tag names and smoke test links. Good job, team. :rocket:
